title: In the same head
body:
Going down to the Rotunda,
i have usurumin my headphones.

In the three minutes I was introducing myself to a part of them I didn't know
my gaze catches a street sweeper
who whistled-even though I didn't hear him.

At the exact same moment, he reached the point in the song
where the singer whistles•
for one and a half seconds
i couldn't separate
what I saw, with what I heard!

Then I realized that
the sounds of the city are not so different from the sounds
that each of us hears inside.

Two worlds aligned
and introduced•
in the same head.
85 — m
